english.title: Proprietor of hackney carriage / PHV failing to facilitate inspection of vehicle - outside Greater London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the proprietor of

(A)_[a hackney carriage,]_
(B)_[a private hire vehicle,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(C)_[licensed by]_
(D)_[in respect of which an application for a licence had been made to]_

**(..SPECIFY THE DISTRICT COUNCIL..), under the Town Police Clauses Act 1847 or under Part II of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976, failed without reasonable excuse to afford the district council such facilities as may have been reasonably necessary to enable them to cause the vehicle to be inspected and tested at a place where the vehicle was kept
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 50(2) and (5) and 76 Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
